name: Further Than Me
tagline: Everyone you've helped can manage without you now. That was always the plan.
epigraph: The 21 Club's house drink for many years. The second herb in it is mine.
glassware: highball glass, chilled, filled with ice
language_row: Wren's checks on v3: title block, whoYouAre and yours swap-tested against the family and run on 4-grams against every pour (in her r4 turns); lint 0 errors; 4 pronoun warnings accepted by Wren (yours 1–4 refer to Brian Rea and Jerry Berns, never the guest). ✓

names_note: *Further Than Me* (2–1, round 4: Wren and Hester; Tomás voted *Gladly Outgrown*), over *Gladly Outgrown*, *Past the House*, *Two Sprigs* and *Their Own Now*. Picks were held until the vote, so there was no crossing.
open_items: **Library gap (Hester):** *B.A.S.T.A.R.D.S.* (Rea, 2017) and Rea's 2021 obituaries were not available; either could turn two of the reading's inferences into fact. Until then they stay labelled as inferences.
The tarragon is our addition, never pinned on the 21 Club (Hester D3); the Southside follows Oxford's tall, lemon build, not the Codex's lime coupe.
